subject: Cannot login to portal
body: Customer reports that since the maintenance window on Jan 12, MFA codes are not being delivered to their phone. They've tried both SMS and the authenticator app. Suspect SS7 outage affecting carrier.

subject: Slow query on /reports
body: The /reports/quarterly endpoint is taking 45-90s. EXPLAIN shows a full scan on transactions_2023. Index on (org_id, created_at) was dropped during the Jan migration — needs recreating.

subject: Refund processed twice
body: Order #ORD-99421 was refunded once via Stripe dashboard and once via the admin panel. Customer received €240 instead of €120. Need to claw back and add a uniqueness check.

subject: API key rotation
body: Vendor PointPro rotated their webhook signing key Jan 15 and we never updated. We've been silently rejecting all their callbacks for 4 days. Replay queue has 1,247 missed events.

subject: UI text typo
body: On the billing page, "recieve" should be "receive". Reported by 3 customers this week.

subject: Export to PDF crashes
body: Exporting an investigation with >500 documents to PDF causes the worker to OOM. Stack trace points to the report-renderer holding all docs in memory at once. Should stream.

subject: GDPR deletion request
body: User ID 1042 has requested account deletion under GDPR Article 17. We need to scrub from primary DB, audit logs (after retention period), and the ML training set.

subject: Mobile app crash on iOS 17.2
body: After the iOS 17.2 update, app crashes on launch for ~12% of iOS users. Crashlytics points to the new SwiftUI navigation stack. Need to ship 4.8.1.
